# @suluk/provision

> Declarative service provisioning for a Suluk app, modelled on the Open Service Broker API and driven like drizzle-kit. Declare the infra you want in one provision.config (D1/KV/R2/secrets/Stripe/domains/tokens as OSB brokers); `plan` diffs desired-vs-live, `apply` walks the binding DAG (provision → poll async last-operation → bind → land credentials in @suluk/env, encrypted + commit-safe), `check` flags drift/orphans. A layer ABOVE @suluk/cloudflare / @suluk/deploy / @suluk/env — it orchestrates, they execute. CANDIDATE tooling.

> Reference tooling for the OpenAPI v4.0 Suluk candidate.

### API

- `defineProvision`: Validate + return a provision config.
- `topoOrder`: Order `instances` so each comes after its binding producers.
- `parseRef`: Parse a single value: a `@ref.key` string → its parts, else null (not a reference).
- `depsOf`: Every instance ref a spec's params depend on (deduped) — the spec's in-edges in the DAG.
- `resolveParams`: Resolve a spec's params against the accumulated outputs (ref → its output map).
- `stableStringify`: A stable JSON string (recursively sorted keys) — order-independent so a fingerprint is reproducible.
- `fingerprint`: The drift fingerprint of a desired instance = a stable hash of (name + plan + params).
- `plan`: Diff `config` against `state`.
- `apply`: Execute the plan for `config`. Idempotent end-to-end: re-running a settled config is all-noops, touches no provider.
- `pollToDone`: Poll an async operation to a terminal state. Throws on "failed" or after `timeoutMs`.
- `checkDrift`: Report whether live state matches the config (orphans counted only when pruning is the config default).
- `assertNoDrift`: Fail-closed: throw when there's any drift (the CI gate).
- `pull`: Fetch each journaled instance's live state via its broker (OSB fetch) → an external-drift report. Read-only.
- `reconcile`: Fold a pull report into the journal: DROP externally-deleted instances (so the next `apply` re-creates them) + MERGE
 live outputs over drifted one...
- `discover`: Discover live instances (via `broker.
- `teardown`: Deprovision the whole journal, consumers-first, honouring `protected`. Destructive — gate it behind confirmation.
- `snapshot`: A snapshot of `config` at migration `idx`.
- `diffSnapshots`: Diff the previous snapshot against the next (current) config → the ordered migration steps.
- `migrationTag`: `NNNN_name` — the zero-padded migration tag.
- `memoryMigrationStore`: An in-memory migration store (tests / dry-runs).
- `fileMigrationStore`: A file-backed migration store rooted at `dir` (default `provision/`).
- `generate`
- `migrate`
- `memoryStore`: A StateStore over an in-memory array (cloned on load/save so callers can't mutate the journal by reference).
- `memorySink`: A BindingSink that records every (envVar → value) it lands — for assertions + a dry-run "what would be set" preview.
- `fileStore`
- `envSink`: A BindingSink that persists bindings into a `.env` via @suluk/env (encrypted by default; commit-safe).
- `cloudflareD1`: D1 database.
- `cloudflareKv`: Workers KV namespace. Provision is create-or-get. Output: `namespace_id`.
- `cloudflareR2`: R2 bucket. Provision is create-or-get. Output: `bucket_name` (R2's id IS its name).
- `cloudflareSecrets`: Worker secrets — the runtime-secret SINK as a broker (this is `sync-secrets.
- `cloudflareToken`: A scoped, least-privilege Cloudflare API token (this is `mint-service-tokens.
- `cloudflareWwwRedirect`: A www → apex 301 redirect (C058) on the zone of `params.
- `cloudflarePagesDomain`
- `defineProvisionApp`: Validate + return a provision app config (the CLI imports this as the config file's default export).
- `runCli`
- `EMPTY_SNAPSHOT`: The empty baseline — the "before the first migration" state, so the first `generate` diffs against nothing.
- `SNAPSHOT_VERSION`

## Optional

### Types

- `OperationState`: OSB last-operation state for an ASYNC provision/deprovision (a database that takes seconds, a cert that takes minutes).
- `ServicePlan`: A plan tier within an offering (OSB Service Plan). Most infra has a single "standard" plan; `free` marks $0 tiers.
- `ServiceOffering`: What a broker can provision (OSB Service Offering). `bindable` = provisioning yields credentials/config to bind.
- `Catalog`: The set of offerings a broker advertises (OSB Catalog).
- `InstanceSpec`: A declared instance the platform WANTS (the desired state — one entry in provision.config).
- `InstanceState`: The live record of a provisioned instance (the journal `plan` diffs against — like drizzle's migration meta).
- `ProvisionRequest`: The resolved request handed to a broker's `provision` (param refs already substituted).
- `ProvisionResult`: A broker's provision outcome — sync (ready now) or async (poll `lastOperation` with `operation`).
- `BindRequest`: The resolved request handed to a broker's `bind`.
- `BindResult`: A broker's bind outcome — the credentials/config the platform + downstream instances consume.
- `OperationRequest`: The request handed to `lastOperation` / `deprovision`.
- `Broker`: The OSB-shaped broker every service implements.
- `BindingSink`: Where bound credentials LAND.
- `StateStore`: The persisted provision journal (desired-vs-live diffing). The default store is a JSON file; a test passes memory.
- `ProvisionPlan`
- `PlanStep`
- `StepAction`
- `ApplyResult`
- `AppliedStep`
- `DriftReport`
- `PullReport`
- `PullEntry`
- `PullStatus`
- `DiscoveredInstance`
- `TeardownResult`
- `Snapshot`
- `Migration`
- `MigrationStep`
- `MigrationStore`
- `MigrationJournal`
- `MigrateResult`
- `ProvisionApp`
- `CliResult`
